# b-MOLA Go

> b-MOLA Go is a portable, medical-grade air purifier featuring advanced NCCO and HEPA filtration technology for removing pollutants, VOCs, bacteria, and viruses.

b-MOLA Go combines innovative NCCO (Nano Confined Catalytic Oxidation) technology developed from HKUST research with medical-grade HEPA filtration to deliver professional-grade air purification in a compact, portable device. The product line focuses on indoor air quality improvement with emphasis on removing PM2.5, VOCs, and harmful pathogens.

## Key Topics

- NCCO Technology
- Medical-Grade HEPA
- Portable Air Purifier
- VOC Removal
- PM2.5 Filtration
- Active Oxygen Generator
- Indoor Air Quality
- Nano Confined Catalytic Oxidation
- Pollutant Removal
- Air Filtration
- Formaldehyde Elimination
- Bacteria & Virus Elimination
- Battery-Powered Design
- Eco-Friendly
